title: Teacher Badge UI, admin moderation controls, and authorized Learning creation entry point

requirements.summary: Create a TeacherBadge overlay (red tick with mini book icon) and render it wherever VerifiedAvatarOverlay is used when teacherBadge=true.
acceptanceCriteria: A new TeacherBadge component exists with an accessible label/title (English), showing a red tick with a mini book icon inside.
VerifiedAvatarOverlay supports showing Teacher Badge as a small bottom-right overlay (similar placement/size to verified badge), without breaking existing verified overlay behavior.
When a user's public profile indicates Teacher Badge=true, the teacher badge overlay is visible on their avatar in the relevant UI surfaces that already use VerifiedAvatarOverlay.
When Teacher Badge=false, the badge is not rendered.

file_operations.description: Add a reusable TeacherBadge overlay component that renders a small red tick badge with a mini book icon inside, including accessible English aria-label/title. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend VerifiedAvatarOverlay props to accept teacherBadge (boolean) and render TeacherBadge as a small bottom-right overlay when true; ensure verified overlay still works and both indicators can coexist without visual breakage. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Pass teacherBadge from the author's PublicProfile into VerifiedAvatarOverlay (and, where applicable, alongside existing verified indicators) so teacher status is visible on post author avatars when teacherBadge=true. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Pass teacherBadge from the viewed user's public profile into VerifiedAvatarOverlay on the profile header so teachers show the overlay when teacherBadge=true. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add AdminUserModerationPanel controls to grant/revoke Teacher Badge with status display and success/error toasts, including React Query cache invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: AdminUserModerationPanel shows the current Teacher Badge status for the selected user (e.g., via a badge/label).
AdminUserModerationPanel provides a button to grant Teacher Badge if the user does not have it and a button to revoke it if the user has it.
Grant/revoke actions call the new backend methods and invalidate relevant React Query caches (user profile, public profile, admin user list, and any lists that render the badge).
Non-admin users cannot access these controls (AdminPage is already guarded; keep that behavior).

file_operations.description: Add React Query mutation hooks for adminGrantTeacherBadge/adminRevokeTeacherBadge that call the backend and invalidate caches for: userProfile, publicProfile, adminAllUserProfiles, userSearch, posts, channelPosts, eventPosts, feedStoryViews (and any other lists that surface avatars/badges). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Display the selected user's current Teacher Badge status (English label) and add Grant/Revoke Teacher Badge buttons wired to the new hooks; show success/error toasts using existing toast + normalizeBackendError patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an authorized (Admin or Teacher Badge) lesson/course creation entry point on LearnPage and hide it for all other users; refresh lessons list on success.
acceptanceCriteria: LearnPage shows an 'Add Lesson' / 'Add Course' action only when the caller is Admin or has Teacher Badge.
Submitting the creation form successfully creates the lesson/course and refreshes the lessons list.
Unauthorized users do not see lesson/course creation controls on LearnPage (and are still blocked by backend if they attempt to call the API).
All user-facing text added for this feature is in English.

file_operations.description: Add a creator-facing addLesson mutation hook that calls the non-admin addLesson backend function and invalidates the lessons query used by LearnPage (and any dependent lesson detail queries if applicable). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a Learning section dialog/component providing an English-labeled 'Add Lesson' and 'Add Course' entry point (with course mapping to the existing lesson creation capability until a distinct course capability exists), including form validation, submit loading state, and success/error toasts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Gate the creation entry point using useIsCallerAdmin and the caller's profile publicProfile.teacherBadge; render the LearnCreateContentDialog only for authorized creators, and ensure successful creation refreshes the visible lessons list. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
